regions.name: support_region
regions.purpose: locates a moving element and reacts its loads

regions.name: working_volume
regions.purpose: the region the output element occupies and travels through

regions.name: travel_limit_region
regions.purpose: bounds the motion of a moving element

regions.name: structural_shell
regions.purpose: carries load and encloses the mechanism

housing_strategy: Two-piece shell with a removable access panel
user_interaction: input_member is the external user interface
assembly_strategy: Insert the mechanism through one open face, then close with a removable panel that carries part of the bearing support
protection_strategy: Moving elements are enclosed; only the user input crosses the boundary
manufacturing_intent: Additive-friendly organisation: flat split, no captive geometry
load_paths: payload -> output element -> guidance -> structural shell -> base
user input -> transmission -> conversion -> output element
proportions: Wide stable base, output travel along the tall axis, drive to one side
risks: travelling member tilts if guidance is weak
binding if the guide and screw axes are not parallel
